 Car crash causes power outages in Rochester’s Upper Falls area on Wednesday
 Hunter Wright News10NBC 
 --> 
 Power outages graphic (Credit: MGN)
 ROCHESTER, N.Y. — Rochester police said a car crash in the area of Upper Falls Boulevard and Joseph Avenue caused a power outage in the area on Wednesday.
 Police said the crash happened about 2:30 p.m., and according to the latest report from police, the area is still without power and is affecting traffic lights. 
 According to RG&E, over 460 customers are without power in that Upper Falls area. As of 7 p.m., power is expected to return to most of the area by 9:30 p.m. with restoration times taking as long as 11:30 p.m.
 You can see the outage map reporting by RG&E here.
